_comment: Capabilities are the WebView's permission to call plugin commands. They do
NOT govern what Rust does — attachments, backups and exports all use
std::fs on the backend and are unaffected by anything listed here.
The fs:* and dialog:* permissions were removed because nothing calls them.
The frontend's only @tauri-apps imports are api/core (invoke), api/app
(getVersion, covered by core:default) and plugin-shell (open, used in
ErrorLog.svelte); no Rust code calls the dialog or fs plugin APIs either,
only their init(). Granting unscoped fs:allow-write-file to a WebView that
never writes files is a standing arbitrary-write primitive for any script
that gets a foothold there — which is exactly the escalation path the xlsx
The plugins are still registered in lib.rs, so restoring any of this is a
one-line change here rather than a code change.
